summary: DoRaa Sangam House e-commerce website with light aesthetic theme (ivory #F8F5F0 + antique gold #C9A96E), premium fonts (Playfair Display, Great Vibes, Lora, Montserrat), login/OTP, Internet Identity, profile dashboard, cart, and product catalog
architectural_notes: Light aesthetic design system: ivory #F8F5F0 background, gradient sections (135deg, #F8F5F0 to #F5F0E6), antique gold #C9A96E primary, blush rose gold #E8C0C8 secondary
Typography stack: Playfair Display ExtraBold (headings, #C9A96E), Great Vibes Regular (special titles, #E8C0C8), Lora Regular (body, #1A1A1A), Montserrat Bold (buttons)
Button styling: antique gold background #C9A96E, dark text, hover effects (deeper gold + lift + glow)
Card components: white #FFFFFF with 1px gold border #C9A96E and soft shadow
Text color hierarchy: deep charcoal #1A1A1A (primary), warm taupe gray #5C4B51 (secondary)
Responsive design: consistent theme across all breakpoints without color/font media query overrides

existing_features.title: Replace all dark navy blue colors with soft warm ivory/pearl cream background (#F8F5F0) throughout the entire application
Apply gradient backgrounds to section elements using linear-gradient(135deg, #F8F5F0 0%, #F5F0E6 100%)
Update primary accent color to antique gold (#C9A96E) for buttons, borders, highlights, and interactive elements
Apply secondary accent color of muted blush rose gold (#E8C0C8) to category titles and decorative elements
Update primary text color to deep charcoal (#1A1A1A) and secondary text to warm taupe gray (#5C4B51)
Style buttons with antique gold background (#C9A96E), dark text, and hover effects with deeper gold, lift animation, and glow
Style product cards and content cards with pure white background (#FFFFFF), 1px gold border (#C9A96E), and soft shadow
Update heading font to Playfair Display ExtraBold with antique gold color (#C9A96E)
Apply Great Vibes Regular font to category titles and special decorative titles with color #E8C0C8
Set body text font to Lora Regular with deep charcoal color (#1A1A1A)
Apply Montserrat Bold font to all button text and call-to-action elements
Remove all media query overrides for colors, fonts, and backgrounds to force identical light theme appearance across desktop, laptop, and mobile viewports
Audit and eliminate all instances of dark navy blue colors from the entire codebase, replacing with the light aesthetic palette

new_feature_requests.summary: Replace dark navy blue theme with stunning light aesthetic theme (ivory/pearl cream #F8F5F0 background, antique gold #C9A96E accents, blush rose gold #E8C0C8 secondary)
Update fonts to premium typography: Playfair Display ExtraBold (headings), Great Vibes Regular (category titles), Lora Regular (body), Montserrat Bold (buttons)
Force consistent theme across desktop/mobile/laptop (no media-query overrides for colors/fonts/background)
Preserve all existing functionality including login/OTP flow, Internet Identity, profile dashboard, cart icon, addresses, orders, and product catalog while applying light theme
